title: Complaint filing
description: Institution of a complaint in a District Commission

steps.step: Identify the jurisdiction of the District Commission where the complaint can be instituted based on the residence or business of the opposite party or parties
Determine if permission from the District Commission is required if the complaint is instituted where any of the opposite parties actually and voluntarily resides or carries on business
Identify the grounds for complaint, such as goods sold or delivered, or services provided, or alleged unfair trade practices

Determine the eligibility to file a complaint as a consumer, recognised consumer association, one or more consumers with the same interest, or the Central Government, Central Authority, or State Government
Prepare the complaint and required documents
File the complaint with the District Commission, which may be done electronically in a prescribed manner
Identify the jurisdiction of the State Commission based on the residence or business of the opposite party or parties
Determine if the complaint can be instituted based on the cause of action or the residence of the complainant
Obtain permission from the State Commission if instituting the complaint based on the voluntary residence or business of one of the opposite parties
